_comment: Package index read by 'hom search/show/install/list --upgradable'. One object per package; see pkgs/README.md for every field. Keep 'version' in sync with the package's own plugin.json (hom compares it with the local one). Edit with 'python tools/pub.py', it fills in sha256 for you.

packages.name: input-overlay
packages.description: Keyboard / mouse / gamepad input overlay presets (WASD, QWERTY, mouse, gamepad).
packages.author: HomRec

packages.name: bter
packages.description: Grab-bag utility plugin (27 console commands - see commands.md section 19) - harmless, no real dependencies, mainly here as something real for `hom install bter` to fetch when testing the package manager itself.
packages.author: HomRec

packages.name: watermark
packages.description: Registers watermark_path/watermark_opacity settings and a "watermark" command to quickly reuse your logo overlay across recordings.
packages.author: homaaio

packages.name: rec-info
packages.description: "recinfo" console command - prints the current recording configuration (resolution, fps, codec, quality, mic, output folder) in one place.
packages.author: homaaio

packages.name: webhook-notify
packages.description: Posts a Discord/Slack incoming-webhook message when recording starts, stops, or an Instant Replay is saved.
packages.author: homaaio

packages.name: soundboard
packages.description: "play <name>" / "soundlist" console commands - plays .wav clips from the plugin's assets folder through your system audio.
packages.author: homaaio

packages.name: clip-organizer
packages.description: Automatically files each Instant Replay save into a dated Clips\YYYY-MM-DD\ subfolder of your output folder.
packages.author: homaaio

packages.name: now-playing
packages.description: "nowplaying" console command - reads the current track from a local now-playing text file (Spotify/foobar2000/etc export) and shows it as a toast.
packages.author: homaaio

packages.name: profiles
packages.description: "profile save|load|list <name>" - named snapshots of resolution/fps/codec/quality/mic settings, one command away (or bind a custom hotkey to a "profile load ..." line).
packages.author: homaaio

packages.name: diag-tools
packages.description: gpuinfo / cpuload / diskfree / activewindow console commands for troubleshooting capture/performance issues.
packages.author: homaaio

packages.name: twitch-info
packages.description: twitchtitle / twitchuptime / twitchfollowers console commands for a configured channel, via the public decapi.me bridge (no OAuth needed).
packages.author: homaaio

packages.name: backup-config
packages.description: "cfgbackup save|list|restore <name>" - timestamped backups of homrec.hrc before you go experimenting with settings.
packages.author: homaaio
